title: Sensitivity Study of Parameters Surrounding Spherical Indexing of Electron Backscatter Diffraction Patterns
content: Spherical indexing of electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) patterns [1] has been shown to be a more robust and reliable technique for indexing EBSD patterns than the conventional Hough transform-based approach. While the spherical indexing technique is not as fast as the Hough transform-based approach, it provides higher angular precision, as well as increased indexing success rates, particularly on noisy diffraction patterns or materials exhibiting pseudosymmetry challenges.
